summary:
Hana Berg is barrow-keep cook who jokes once and still checks for curses. The life that shows in public is anchored at Hearth under Barrow Keep. Hana feeds Barrow Keep through a long siege and will not serve anyone who hides a wound. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Hearty, funny, and strict about gloves off at the table. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: the calm is practiced because panic once cost them someone which is why the welcome has rules. If that truth surfaces at Hearth under Barrow Keep, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
